title: DSAProblem
description: Standard schema specification for algorithmic problems in the DSA Confidence Engine

id.description: Unique identifier for the problem (slug formatted, alphanumeric, underscores, or hyphens)

description.description: Full problem statement including input/output rules and constraints

topic_tags.description: Categorical DSA topic tags (e.g. array, dynamic-programming, graph)

language.description: Target programming language for candidate submissions

entrypoint.description: Primary function name expected in the candidate code

entrypoint_aliases.description: Acceptable alternate function names (camelCase, snake_case, solve, etc.)

starter_code.description: Optional boilerplate code or function stub provided to the candidate

tests.description: Test cases evaluated to verify functional correctness

name.description: Human-readable test case label or description

input.description: JSON-serialized dictionary of keyword arguments passed to the entrypoint

expected_output.description: JSON-serialized expected return value from the entrypoint

description.description: Optional notes or edge case explanation

accepted_strategies.description: List of accepted algorithmic strategies for this problem

required_concepts.description: DSA concept IDs that MUST be present and reachable in candidate code

optional_concepts.description: DSA concept IDs that may be used or mentioned without penalty

primary_concepts.description: Primary concept tags evaluated for scoring fidelity
